claim: Amazon posted $624.9B in total assets for fiscal year 2024.
summary: Amazon's FY2024 Form 10-K (year ended December 31, 2024) reports total assets of $624,894 million, which rounds to $624.9B, directly supporting the claim.

sub_claims.text: Amazon's total assets for fiscal year 2024 were $624.9B
sub_claims.stated_text: $624.9B in total assets for fiscal year 2024
sub_claims.note: Amazon 2024 10-K Consolidated Balance Sheets reports total assets of $624,894M as of Dec 31, 2024, consistent with $624.9B within rounding to one decimal.

sub_claims.text: The reporting period is fiscal year 2024
sub_claims.note: Amazon's fiscal year is calendar year ending Dec 31; FY2024 corresponds to year ended Dec 31, 2024 covered by the 2024 10-K.
